notes:
Account background: Moonstone builds an in-app conversational assistant and knowledge search for a mid-market B2B product suite. Engineering-heavy product org (backend + infra emphasis). They signed up for Hosted API in Nov 2025 to prototype; now evaluating Dedicated for production scale and data isolation.

Recent timeline / activity (bullets from AE/SE notes):
- 2025-11-12: inbound signup, quickstart test with Hosted API (low volume). AE intro call: Ariella.
- 2025-12-03: Demo of Redwood Console + latency dashboard. Positive on token accounting; wants clearer per-route costs.
- 2026-01-18: SE deep-dive (Diego). POC scope agreed: 2-week POC using chat + embeddings; dataset = product docs + support transcripts (~75k docs). Fireflies: ff_20260118_1045.
- 2026-02-12: POC interim review: throughput targets met on Hosted API but cost per 1M tokens ~ $X higher than internal target. Discussed Dedicated savings and quantization options. Fireflies: ff_20260212_1832.
- 2026-02-20: Pricing/packaging kickoff with pricing ops. Customer requested committed throughput tiers, burst window, overage unit pricing, and a 6-month ramp schedule.

POC outcomes & technical notes:
- Workloads: chat (multi-turn), high-accuracy reranking for SERP-like results, and embeddings for semantic search.
- Latency targets: p95 generation < 250ms for short prompts (<=256 tokens), acceptable tail to 400ms for longer contexts.
- Throughput target: steady-state ~ 10 req/s (avg) with spikes up to 65 req/s during peak campaigns.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market constraints; CFO wants committed discount to get unit cost < $0.0008/token equivalent in steady state.
- Model preference: Llama2/Redwood-curated 70B quantized candidate; fallback to smaller 13B for burst or cheap routing.
- Routing needs: region-aware routing (NA primary), fallback to lower-cost variant when Dedicated pool saturated.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, and KMS integration for key management. Data residency in US only.

Pricing asks from customer (direct quotes/paraphrase):
- "We need a 12-month commit but want a 90-day ramp period where committed QPS grows from 20% to 100%."
- "Burst credit pool for sustained 5-min spikes is important — at least 3x our committed peak for 1 hour/month."
- "Overage pricing must be predictable — prefer per-token overage with soft caps and automatic throttles before hard overage."

Current Redwood proposal (high level supplied by pricing ops):
- Commit tiers: Bronze (baseline) = reserved GPU capacity equivalent to 15 QPS, Silver = 35 QPS, Gold = 75 QPS.
- Ramp schedule: explicit 90-day scale window with prorated usage credit during ramp.
- Burst: monthly burst credits (5% of monthly commit as baseline) + option to purchase burst addons.
- Overage: tiered per-token overage with de-escalation routing to 13B model when overage triggers.
- Discounts: stepped discount based on 12-month commit + usage forecast.

Customer feedback on proposal:
- Likes explicit QPS-based tiers and ramp language.
- Pushback: burst credit baseline too small; asks for 3x burst for the first quarter during go-to-market.
- Wants clearer SLA language around preemption and fallbacks (impact on latency during fallbacks).
- Legal requested DPA + SOC2 artifact before procurement sign-off.

Next steps (short):
- AE Ariella to send revised pricing sheet reflecting: expanded burst credits for first 90 days, a 6-month optional step-down discount, and explicit per-token overage caps. (Due: 2026-03-03)
- SE Diego to produce a short runbook showing how routing -> 13B fallback impacts latency & correctness (Due: 2026-03-05).
- Customer procurement to start legal review once DPA + SOC2 report provided.

Open questions / blockers for close:
- Procurement calendar: prefers invoice-based monthly billing but finance needs annual PO for budget — timing mismatch.
- SOC2 log retention request (customer wants 13 months); Redwood standard is 12 months — needs legal exception.
- Final commit level: customer comfortable with Silver if burst and ramp protections improved.

Sales notes (AE voice, shorthand):
- High intent; technical champions (Head of Platform + Senior ML Eng) aligned. C-level wants clear ARR math.
- Risk areas: procurement timing, SOC2 retention, CFO will re-run cost model if per-token numbers don't hit target.
- Win signal: asks for custom burst pool in contract => strong product-market fit for their bursty marketing windows.
